QuestInfo.name: Packed Lunch For Kids
QuestInfo.0: Elex, Edelstein's grumpy old kindergarten teacher, is here for a field trip with the kids. Go visit them at the #b#e#m223020100##k#n.
QuestInfo.1: The kids are hungry! get Picnic Lunch Boxes from Al Scapone in #m223020100#.
QuestInfo.2: You took the Picnic Lunch Boxes back to Elex to give to the kids.

0.0: Babysitting all these kids is no picnic, lemme tell you. We brought all the kindergarteners out for a Fantasy Theme World field trip, but they're a handful. Can you help me out?\r\n

yes.0: I forgot to pack lunches for the kids! Can you get some lunch boxes from that snack bar? Please?

no.0: These kids are hard to keep entertained... I could really use some help.

yes.0: Whew, that was tough. The kids get so antsy when they're hungry.

item.0: You still didn't bring the Picnic Lunch Boxes? I need 5 total. Buy them from Al Scapone, okay?
